  • Method Details

    • recoveryCodesPage

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/login/second-factor/recovery-codes", produces="text/html") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> recoveryCodesPage()
      GET /login/second-factor/recovery-codes : Renders the recovery codes of a new authenticator app, once Renders the recovery codes generated when the signed-in user enrolled an authenticator app on the second-factor page, which redirects here after the enrolment code is accepted. The codes are kept in the session only until this page is rendered, so a second request shows none. Its Continue link resumes the request the sign-in interrupted (typically /oauth2/authorize), or goes to the root when there is none. A request without a signed-in session is redirected to the sign-in page.
      Returns:
      The recovery codes page. (status code 200)
